description: The bench's copy of a feedback answer until admin has it (jarvis.chat.feedback_outbox). One row per feedback identity, named {kind}-{sha1(kind:ref:user)[:20]} by the controller, so a re-rating replaces the row rather than adding one. No 'autoname' key by design: 'hash' would turn a name collision into a silent new random name instead of a DuplicateEntryError.

fields.label: Kind
fields.description: Reply = a thumbs rating on one assistant reply; Session = the once-per-session popup; Pulse = the periodic business survey.

fields.label: Reference
fields.description: What was rated: the Jarvis Chat Message (Reply), the Jarvis Conversation (Session) or the survey period key (Pulse).

fields.label: User
fields.description: The session user who answered. Data, not a Link, so a pending row never blocks deleting the user.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Pending = stored, admin has not acknowledged it yet. Delivered = admin acknowledged it. Failed = admin refused it, or every retry failed.

fields.label: Attempts
fields.description: Delivery attempts for the current revision. A rate-limited attempt is not counted.

fields.label: Next Retry At
fields.description: When the retry sweep may send a Pending row again. Empty once Delivered or Failed.

fields.label: Revision
fields.description: Bumped on every new answer for this identity. A delivery marks the row Delivered only while the revision it sent is still current.

fields.label: Last Error
fields.description: Why the last attempt did not deliver, bounded to 200 chars. Admin error text is already scrubbed by admin_client; any other failure records its class name only.

fields.label: Payload
fields.description: The exact item admin's ingest takes, as JSON: ratings, refs and the bounded optional note. Never the reply text. Permlevel 1 with no role granted, so Desk shows delivery state without the answer itself.

name: Jarvis Feedback Outbox
